services.name: Acne Back Treatment
services.description: An acne back facial is a specialized treatment designed to cleanse, exfoliate, and treat acne-prone skin on the back. The process typically begins with a deep cleansing to remove impurities and excess oil. Next, exfoliation is performed, often using scrubs or chemical peels, to slough off dead skin cells and unclog pores. Following this, extractions may be done to remove any blackheads or blemishes. The treatment often includes the application of masks or serums containing acne-fighting ingredients like salicylic acid or benzoyl peroxide, and it concludes with the application of a soothing moisturizer. This facial aims to reduce back acne, improve skin texture, and promote overall skin health.
